chats.answer:
Yes. Many solar inverters can operate without a battery, but the right type depends on whether you want to use solar power while the utility grid is available or during a power outage.

3 types of batteryless solar inverters

Inverter type

	

Works without battery?

	

Works during grid outage?




Grid-tie inverter

	

Yes

Hybrid inverter with batteryless operation

	

Yes

	

Depends on model




Off-grid inverter with PV-direct operation

	

Yes, on select models

	

Yes, when sunlight is sufficient

The important distinction is that not every hybrid or off-grid inverter supports batteryless operation.

For example, some hybrid inverters can run without a battery while connected to the grid, but require a battery to supply backup power during an outage.

One important question

Off-grid: Solar panels power appliances directly, without a battery or utility grid.

Grid outage backup: Solar panels power my house during the day when the grid goes down.

Grid-tied: Use solar power to reduce electricity bills, without batteries.

Find compatible inverters

This distinction matters because a batteryless inverter that works while connected to the grid may shut down completely when the grid fails.

Yes. There are solar inverters that work without batteries. The right type depends on whether you want to use solar power while connected to the utility grid or operate independently of it.

Three types of batteryless solar inverters
